_README: Literature H-diffusivity Arrhenius laws, consumed by diffusivity_plot.py.
Top-level keys are materials and must match the run-folder stem: a folder
'Al_supercell_10H' looks for the key 'Al' (matching ignores case, spaces
and underscores, so 'Al', 'al' and 'Al_supercell' all work).
Any key starting with '_' is documentation and is ignored by the loader.
Each entry is drawn ONLY across its own T_C window - a study measured over
300-600 C is never extrapolated to meet the MD points.
A malformed entry is reported on stderr and dropped; the rest still plot.

_SCHEMA.label: REQUIRED. Citation as it should appear in the legend, e.g. 'Zhang et al. 2026'.
_SCHEMA.D0: REQUIRED. Pre-exponential factor, as printed in the source.
_SCHEMA.Ea: REQUIRED. Activation energy, as printed in the source.
_SCHEMA.T_C: REQUIRED (or T_K). Validity range [low, high] in degrees Celsius.
_SCHEMA.T_K: Alternative to T_C: validity range [low, high] in Kelvin.
_SCHEMA.note: OPTIONAL. Free-text provenance - method, purity, DOI. Not plotted.
